meta.formula: r_hat_jb(t) = ridge(r_ub lags, dev10/20, r_uj lag, weekday dummies + weekday x r_ub(t-1) interactions) - mu_uj
meta.why: JPY/BDT = (BDT/USD) / (JPY/USD); the managed USD/BDT leg mean-reverts with WEEKDAY-dependent strength (Monday beta ~ -1) and also reverts to its 10/20-day mean; USD/JPY is a random walk
